title: Claims of secret ships to Europa heard at Contact in the Desert
place_text: Contact in the Desert conference / Europa

tellings.quote: It could be possible we're sending ships to Europa on a regular basis

plain: Speakers at Contact in the Desert, a UFO conference, are said to have claimed that ships are being sent in secret to Europa, a moon of Jupiter. A guest named Peter Levenda tells this as something he heard said there: "It could be possible we're sending ships to Europa on a regular basis." If true, it would mean a hidden space programme reaching far beyond anything made public.
